# Kortscore

> Kortscore is a free scorekeeper app for tennis and padel that runs on the watch: one tap per point on the wrist, the phone stays in the bag. Spectators follow a live score ticker through a shareable link without installing anything. Made by swordi.studios, an independent studio in Vienna, Austria.

## What it does

- Scores tennis and padel matches, singles and doubles, with one tap per point on a smartwatch
- Handles the rules: advantage and NoAd scoring, tiebreaks, sets to 4 or 6
- Live score ticker: a link the player shares, spectators open it in any browser, no app or account needed
- Match history with point-by-point log, statistics such as win rate and set record
- Free, no ads, no account. Kortscore Plus is an optional one-time in-app purchase for deeper statistics
- Interface in English and German

## Platforms

Android (8.0+) phones with Wear OS (3+) watches. Runs on every Wear OS 3 watch (Samsung Galaxy Watch 4 and newer, every Google Pixel Watch, OnePlus Watch 2/3, TicWatch Pro 5, Xiaomi Watch 2, and others; full list at https://kortscore.com/compatible-watches.html). A three-set match uses about 15 to 25 percent of the watch battery. An iOS and Apple Watch version is in development.

## Get it

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.swordistudios.kortscore
